A holder whose only sign of being foreign is its name (jurisdiction/entity markers, _shp_dii_rowfix.FORLAB or the sovereign-name rule) counts as FII only when listed here. Proof = (filing) the holder appears under a foreign-institution row (FPI/FII/FVCI/FDI/foreign SWF/Institutions(Foreign)) in another cached BSE SHP XBRL, with no domestic listing or >= 90% of >= 5 listings; or (gleif) a GLEIF LEI record with the same legal name (or previous legal name) and a legal jurisdiction outside India. Unlisted name-only holders are unresolved (never FII by name alone).
